title: God is good all the time
lyrics_original: God is good all the time
He put a song of praise in this heart of mine
God is good all the time
Through the darkest night, His light will shine
God is good, God is good all the time (2)
If you're walking through the valleys
And there are shadows all around
Do not fear, He will guide you
He will keep you safe and sound
He has promised to never leave you
Nor forsake you, and His word is true      || God is good ||
We were sinners and so unworthy
Still for us He chose to die
Filled us with His Holy Spirit
Now we can stand and testify
That His love is everlasting
And His mercies, they will never end     || God is good ||
Though I may not understand
All the plans you have for me
My life is in your hands
And through the eyes of faith
I can clearly see that          || God is good ||

bible_verses.telugu: యెహోవా దయాళుడు ఆయన కృప నిత్యముండును ఆయన సత్యము తరతరములుండును.
bible_verses.english: For the Lord is good and his love endures forever; his faithfulness continues through all generations.

bible_verses.telugu: గాఢాంధకారపు లోయలో నేను సంచరించినను ఏ అపాయమునకు భయపడనునీవు నాకు తోడై యుందువు నీ దుడ్డుకఱ్ఱయు నీదండమును నన్ను ఆదరించును.
bible_verses.english: Even though I walk through the darkest valley, I will fear no evil, for you are with me; your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

bible_verses.telugu: తనకు స్తోత్రరూపమగు క్రొత్తగీతమును మన దేవుడు నా నోట నుంచెను. అనేకులు దాని చూచి భయభక్తులుగలిగి యెహోవా యందు నమి్మకయుంచెదరు.
bible_verses.english: He put a new song in my mouth, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and fear the Lord and put their trust in him.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God, thank You for Your unwavering goodness that shines bright even in my darkest moments. When life feels uncertain and shadows surround me, help me to remember Your promise never to leave my side. Put a new song of praise in my heart today as I choose to trust Your loving guidance. Thank You for keeping me safe in Your care, now and always. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord God, thank You for Your unwavering goodness that shines bright even in my darkest moments. When life feels uncertain and shadows surround me, help me to remember Your promise never to leave my side. Put a new song of praise in my heart today as I choose to trust Your loving guidance. Thank You for keeping me safe in Your care, now and always. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: God’s goodness is not dependent on our fleeting circumstances; it is the constant foundation of His eternal character. Even when deep shadows fall across our path, He faithfully shines His light and places a fresh song of praise within our hearts. He promises to walk alongside us through every dark valley, guarding our steps with quiet assurance. Today, let us open our hearts to His presence, trusting that His constant love will carry us through every season.
